DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出荷する苗を数え始めましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you started counting the seedlings for dispatch?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。黄色い花のトレーに、赤い花のラベルが付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 花の色とラベルが一致しないトレーを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. A tray of yellow flowers has a red-flower label.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a tray whose flower color and label do not match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのトレーは動かさずに置いてください。ほかにも同じ組み合わせがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Leave that tray unmoved. Are there others with the same combination?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣の二つも同じです。ラベルだけ取り替えてよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ不一致の数を伝えてラベル交換の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The two beside it are the same. I'm unsure whether I should replace just the labels.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State how many share the mismatch and ask whether labels may be replaced. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見た目だけでは品種を決められないので、栽培記録と照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can't determine varieties from appearance alone, so we'll compare with cultivation records.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認が済むまで、この三つを出荷分から外しておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認待ちの苗を出荷対象から外すか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Until the check is finished, should we remove these three from the dispatch group?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether to exclude seedlings awaiting checks from dispatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、私と一緒に確認用の棚へ移しましょう。元の位置も記録しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, let's move them together to the checking shelf. We'll record the original locations too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 棚へ移す前に、元の列とトレーの番号を書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移動前に元の位置と番号を記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before moving them to the shelf, I'll write down the original row and tray numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record original locations and numbers before moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。残りの苗はラベルと出荷表を照合してから数えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Compare the remaining seedlings' labels with the dispatch list before counting.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残りを先に確認して数えます。違うラベルがまた見つかったら、まとめずに知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残りの照合と再発見時の報告方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the remaining ones first and count them. If I find another wrong label, I'll report it without grouping it with the others.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm checking the remainder and how to report further mismatches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 助かります。まず一緒にこの三つを移しましょう、お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: That helps. First let's move these three together. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は何人分のお魚をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many people are you buying fish for today?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今夜は一人ですが、二尾入りを買って明日の弁当にも使おうかと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今夜と翌日の用途を示して二尾入りを検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Just me tonight, but I'm considering a two-fish pack to use for tomorrow's lunch box too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain tonight's and tomorrow's uses when considering two fish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 明日は加熱する時間がありますか。それとも今夜まとめて調理されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you have time to cook tomorrow, or will you prepare both tonight?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 明日の朝は早いので、今夜焼いて持っていくつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 翌朝の時間制約と調理予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an early start tomorrow, so I was planning to grill it tonight and take it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain tomorrow morning's time constraint and your cooking plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調理後の保管はお客様の環境によりますね。一尾だけ買える商品もありますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Storage after cooking depends on your circumstances. We also have products sold as a single fish.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 弁当は別の物にします。一尾売りで、フライパンに収まる魚はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 弁当用購入をやめて小さい一尾売りを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use something else for lunch. Do you have a single fish that fits in a frying pan?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Abandon the lunch-box purchase and ask for a small fish sold individually. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらなら小さめです。頭と内臓を取る下処理をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: This one is small. Would you like the head and innards removed?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。切り身より丸ごとの魚を焼いてみたいのですが、うろこも取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 頭と内臓に加えてうろこの除去を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I'd like to try grilling a whole fish rather than a fillet. Can you remove the scales too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request scale removal as well as the head and innards. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: うろこも取りますね。骨は残りますので、食べるときに気をつけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll remove the scales too. Bones remain, so be careful when eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、この一尾にします。寄り道せずに帰るので、保冷用の氷も付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一尾の購入を決めて持ち帰り用の氷を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll take this one fish. I'm going straight home without stopping, so please add ice to keep it cool.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose one fish and request ice for taking it home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 下処理して氷と一緒にお包みします。お買い上げありがとうございます、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll prepare and wrap it with ice. Thank you for buying, and take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 室内干しの売場はこちらです。取り付ける場所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Indoor laundry drying products are here. Have you decided where to install one?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 窓の近くに干したいのですが、借りている部屋なので壁に穴を開けられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 賃貸で穴を開けられない設置条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to dry clothes near the window, but I rent the room and can't drill holes in the wall.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the rented-room installation condition of no drilling. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 穴を開けずに置くタイプならあります。窓の前に床の空きはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have freestanding types that need no holes. Is there free floor space in front of the window?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 床には箱があって狭いです。この突っ張り式なら使えそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 床が狭いことを説明して突っ張り式を検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are boxes on the floor, so it's cramped. Could I use this tension-mounted type?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain limited floor space and consider a tension-mounted model. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取り付け面と天井の高さによります。高さを測っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It depends on the mounting surfaces and ceiling height. Have you measured the height?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 天井は測っていません。今ある物干しを直せるなら、部品だけ買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 天井の寸法が不明と伝えて修理部品の購入を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't measured the ceiling. If I can repair my current drying rack, I'd like to buy just a part.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain unknown ceiling dimensions and ask about repair parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 部品を合わせるには、今の物干しの型番と壊れた部分が必要ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: To match a part, we need your rack's model number and the damaged section.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 型番は家に戻れば分かります。先に部品を買わず、調べてから来たほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 型番を調べるまで部品購入を待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can find the model number when I go home. I should check it before returning rather than buy a part first, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm waiting to purchase parts until the model number is checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのほうが合わない物を買わずに済みます。壊れた箇所もメモしておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That avoids buying an incompatible item. Note the damaged area too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は買わずに帰ります。型番と壊れた箇所、それから天井の高さも調べてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入を保留して型番と破損箇所と高さを調べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't buy anything today. I'll check the model number, damaged area and ceiling height and bring them back.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off purchasing and check the model, damage and height. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 寸法が分かれば選択肢を比べられますよ。またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: With the dimensions, we can compare options. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お待たせしました。こちらが持ち帰りの二つです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Thank you for waiting. Here are your two takeaway orders.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。片方は同僚の分なので、辛くないほうを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同僚用の辛くない注文を識別するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. One is for my coworker; please show me which is the nonspicy one.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to identify the nonspicy order for your coworker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 辛くないほうには白いシールを貼りました。もう一つには辛いソースが入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I've put a white sticker on the nonspicy one. The other contains spicy sauce.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 白いシールが同僚の分ですね。箸は一膳しか見えませんが、もう一膳いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 注文の印を確認して不足している箸を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The white sticker is my coworker's, then. I only see one pair of chopsticks; could I have another pair?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the order marker and request the missing chopsticks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 失礼しました、二膳にします。袋は一つでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sorry, I'll make it two pairs. Is one bag all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別々の場所で食べるので、袋も二つに分けてもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食べる場所が別なので袋を分けるよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll eat in different places, so separate bags would help too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request separate bags because you will eat in different places. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの袋に一つずつ入れました。熱い容器ですから底を支えてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've put one in each bag. The containers are hot, so support the bottoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 白いシールが隠れました。辛くないほうの袋にも印を付けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容器の印が隠れたため袋にも印を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The white sticker is hidden now. Could you mark the nonspicy bag too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a bag marker because the container's marker is hidden. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、こちらの袋にも白いシールを付けます。これで区別できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I'll put a white sticker on this bag too. Now you can distinguish them.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: これなら渡し間違えません。支払いは済んでいるので、二袋を受け取っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 識別できると伝えて支払い済みの二袋を受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: This way I won't hand over the wrong one. I've already paid, so I'll take the two bags now.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you can identify them and collect the two paid bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お支払いは確認できています。ありがとうございました、気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, payment is confirmed. Thank you, and carry them home carefully.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その椅子に座ってみて、いかがでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: How did that chair feel when you sat on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 座り心地はよいです。この展示してある椅子そのものを買うことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 座り心地を評価して展示椅子自体の購入可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's comfortable. Can I buy this actual display chair?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Evaluate the comfort and ask to buy the display chair itself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 販売できるか確認しますね。展示品ですので、脚の小さな傷もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check whether we can sell it. Since it's a display item, please look at the small scratches on the legs too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 脚の傷は気になりませんが、座面の裏も見てから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 脚の傷は受け入れて座面裏の状態を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The leg scratches don't bother me, but I'd like to see under the seat before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept the leg scratches and request a check under the seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、安全に横にしてお見せします。布が破れていないか、こちらで確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I'll safely lay it on its side. You can check here whether the fabric is torn.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 裏は大丈夫そうです。今日は自転車なので、買っても持って帰れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 裏の状態を確認して自転車では運べないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The underside looks all right. I came by bicycle today, so I can't carry it home even if I buy it.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the underside and explain that you cannot transport it by bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お車で引き取りに来られますか。取り置きできる期間を担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you collect it by car? I'll ask the staff how long we can hold it.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日曜日なら友人の車で来られます。それまで置いてもらえるなら購入したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日曜日の車での引き取りを条件に購入希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can come in my friend's car on Sunday. I'd like to buy it if you can keep it until then.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Express purchase interest conditional on car collection on Sunday. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 販売の可否と日曜日までの保管を確認してから、合計額をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking sale availability and storage until Sunday, we'll give you the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認をお願いします。持ち帰る際の梱包が必要かも、そのときに教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 販売と保管に加えて持ち帰りの梱包を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please check. At the same time, please tell me whether packing will be needed for taking it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check take-home packing as well as sale and storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました、担当者を呼んでまいります。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly, I'll call the person in charge. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 朝の巡回で気づいたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you notice anything on the morning round?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 東側の通路に板が置かれています。避難経路の線をまたいでいるのが気になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 避難用通路の線をまたぐ板の位置を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a board in the east passage. I was concerned that it crosses the evacuation-route line.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the board crossing the evacuation passage line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 板の近くには行かずに教えてください。通路を完全にふさいでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me without going near the board. Does it block the passage completely?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 片側は通れますが、二人で並んで通る幅はありません。自分で動かしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残る通路幅を説明して単独で動かしてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One side is passable, but there's not enough width for two people side by side. May I move it myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain remaining passage width and ask about moving it alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一人で動かさないでください。資材の担当者と置き場所を確認してから対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't move it alone. We'll act after checking the storage location with the materials staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者を待つ間、私は東側を通る予定だった台車運搬を止めておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 東側通路を使う台車運搬を止めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: While waiting for them, I'll stop the trolley transport that was going to use the east passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stop trolley transport planned for the east passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうしてください。運搬再開は私が通路を確認してから指示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. I'll instruct a restart after checking the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別の通路を使えば続けられそうですが、そちらも確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別経路での作業継続の可否を責任者に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It looks possible to continue using another passage, but could you check that route too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the supervisor whether work may continue via another route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別経路の状況も見ます。それまでは台車を指定の待機場所に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll inspect the other route too. Until then, put the trolley in its designated waiting spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待機場所へ戻し、運搬を中断します。通路の確認が終わるまで再開しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 台車を待機場所へ戻して再開指示を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll return it to the waiting spot and suspend transport. I won't resume until the passage check is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the trolley to its waiting spot and wait for restart instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 私が現地を確認しに行きます。報告ありがとう、お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll inspect the site. Thank you for reporting and for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その封筒をお出しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to send that envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ書類を返したいのですが、自分の住所を表に大きく書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返送封筒の表に自分の住所を書いた誤りを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to return documents to my company, but I wrote my own address large on the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain mistakenly writing your own address on the return envelope's front. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社の宛先はどこに書いてありますか。封筒を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where is the company's destination address? May I see the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社の住所は下の小さい文字です。このままだと自分の家に届くかもしれませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社の宛先の位置を示して誤配の可能性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The company's address is the small writing below. Could this arrive at my own home as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the company's address position and ask about misdelivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛先と差出人が分かりにくいですね。新しい封筒へ書き直すのがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's hard to distinguish the destination and sender. It would be better to rewrite it on a new envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら新しい封筒を使います。差出人は裏に書けば見分けやすいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新しい封筒を使い差出人を裏に書く位置を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll use a new envelope. Would putting the sender on the back make it clearer?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use a new envelope and check putting the sender on the reverse. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、表に会社の住所と宛名、裏にご自身の住所とお名前を書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, put the company's address and addressee on the front, and your own address and name on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社名だけでなく、担当者の名前も表に書きます。部署が分からない場合は空けてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当者名を加えて不明な部署の記載方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put the contact person's name on the front as well as the company. If I don't know the department, may I leave it blank?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add the contact name and ask how to handle an unknown department. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かっている宛先情報で届くか、会社に確認すると確実ですね。誤った部署名は書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Checking with the company whether the known details suffice is the surest approach. Don't write an incorrect department.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書類は持ち帰って、部署を会社に聞いてから封筒を書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部署を会社に確認するため発送を保留すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the documents home and rewrite the envelope after asking the company for the department.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off mailing to check the department with the company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 宛先が分かったら、またお持ちください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KASAOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Bring it again when you know the destination. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その川の絵は、少し離れて見ると全体の構図がわかりやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: It's easier to see that river painting's overall composition from a little farther away.

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 解説に「余白を生かす」とありますが、何も描いていない所も作品の一部ですか。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 解説の「余白」が描かれていない部分も含むのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The explanation says 'use negative space.' Are the places with nothing painted part of the work too?
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the unpainted areas are included in the explanation's negative space. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、この絵では、岸と空の間の淡い部分が広がりを感じさせています。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. In this painting, the pale area between the bank and sky creates a sense of spaciousness.

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 白い所だけを見るより、舟との距離を見ればよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 余白と舟の距離に注目する見方を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Should I look at its distance from the boat rather than only the white areas?
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check an approach focusing on the distance between negative space and the boat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 舟の周りにどれくらい空間があるか比べると、違いに気づきやすいですね。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Comparing how much space surrounds the boat makes differences easier to notice.

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: なるほど、舟が小さいので、川が広く見えるんですね。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 舟の小ささが川の広さを感じさせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I see. The boat is small, so the river looks wide.
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain how the small boat makes the river feel wide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そういう見方もできますね。ご自身が感じたことをメモしてみてはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's one way to see it. Why not note your own impressions?

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 絵は撮らずに、手帳に構図を簡単に描いても構いませんか。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真ではなく手帳に構図を描けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Instead of photographing the painting, may I make a simple sketch of the composition in my notebook?
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to sketch the composition in a notebook rather than photograph it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この展示室では鉛筆のメモはできますが、通路の中央ではなく脇の椅子をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pencil notes are allowed in this gallery, but use the chairs at the side rather than the middle of the passage.

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 椅子に移って、舟と空間の関係を鉛筆で残します。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 椅子で舟と空間の関係を鉛筆で記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll move to a chair and record the relationship between the boat and space in pencil.
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the boat-space relationship in pencil from a chair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくり。ほかの絵との違いも楽しんでくださいね。
DLG-SC-OKY-KURASHIKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take your time. Enjoy comparing it with the other paintings too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 二名様の順番です。お連れの方もこちらにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's the turn for two people. Is your companion here too?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 友人が近くのトイレに行っています。私だけ先に乗って席を取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同行者がトイレにいると伝え一人で席を取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: My friend is in a nearby toilet. Can I board first alone and save a seat?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain your companion is in the toilet and ask whether you can save a seat alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 乗船の案内はお二人そろってからにしましょう。友人の方とは連絡が取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's arrange boarding after both of you are together. Can you contact your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 電話はつながりましたが、ここに戻るまで五分ほどかかるそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 電話で聞いた同行者の到着まで約五分と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I reached them by phone, but they say it will take about five minutes to return here.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report your companion's phone estimate of about five minutes until arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この便を待たせることはできないので、次に乗れる便を確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: We can't hold this sailing, so I'll check the next one you can board.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今の順番を見送った場合、整理券は取り直しになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 便を見送る場合の整理券の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: If I let this turn go, will I need a new numbered ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask what happens to the numbered ticket if you skip this sailing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この整理券はそのままお持ちください。お二人そろったら、私にもう一度お声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Keep this ticket. Speak to me again once you're both here.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 戻ったらこの券を見せます。待つ場所は乗船口の横でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二人そろって券を見せると確認し待機位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll show this ticket when they return. May we wait beside the boarding entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm showing the ticket together and ask where to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 乗船口は空けていただき、あちらの待機場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please keep the boarding entrance clear and wait at that waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 友人にも待機場所を伝えて、二人で改めて声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 同行者にも待機場所を伝え二人で係員に声をかけると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll tell my friend the waiting area and we'll both come speak to you again.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Tell your companion the waiting location and approach the attendant together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お待ちいただきありがとうございます。それでは、お連れの方が戻られましたらどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you for waiting. Please come once your companion returns.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 見本と並べて、今織った部分の縞を見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's compare the stripes you just wove with the sample beside them.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 赤い縞の幅が、見本より一段広くなっています。ここで作業を止めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 赤い縞が一段広いと報告し作業を止めたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The red stripe is one row wider than the sample. I've stopped working here.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report a red stripe one row too wide and that you stopped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 止めてくれて助かります。どの段から違っているか指で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you for stopping. Can you point out which row starts the difference?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この赤い縞の始まりからです。その前の白い部分は見本と同じ幅です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 違いが始まる赤い縞と正常な白い部分を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: From the beginning of this red stripe. The white section before it is the same width as the sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the red stripe where the difference begins and the correct white section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確かにここですね。すぐにほどかず、まず糸の本数を一緒に数えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, here. Don't unpick it immediately; first let's count the threads together.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 赤い糸は見本では四本なのに、ここは五本入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 見本の赤糸四本に対して五本入っていると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The sample has four red threads, but this has five.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report five red threads compared with four in the sample. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 原因を確認できましたね。この部分を戻すやり方は私が見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: We've identified the cause. I'll demonstrate how to undo this section.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 戻し方を見てから、同じ所を一度やって確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 戻し方の実演後に自分の操作を確認してもらうよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: After I watch how to undo it, could I try the same part once and have you check?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request a check of your own attempt after the undoing demonstration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ええ、一本戻すたびに声をかけてください。続きは幅を確認してから織りましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, call me after undoing each thread. Check the width before weaving more.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 一本ずつ戻して確認を受け、四本の幅にそろってから続きを織ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 一本ずつ確認を受け四本の幅に直してから織ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll undo one thread at a time and have it checked, then continue once the width matches four threads.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Receive checks one thread at a time and continue weaving only after restoring the four-thread width. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: その進め方でお願いします。お疲れ様です、実演が始まるまで道具を置いてお待ちくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please follow that approach. Thank you for your work; put down the tools and wait for the demonstration to begin.
